billing_notes: International pay-as-you-go API prices across published modalities. Subscription/Token Plans and Chinese-region billing are separate products; discounts and prompt bands remain native expressions.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: * **Billing units:** Depending on the service, charges are based on tokens, characters, duration, images, voices, or requests. See the relevant pricing table for the exact unit.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: * **Image input**: The first **5 images** per task are free; additional images are billed per image. The unit price does not vary with image or output video resolution.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: * **MiniMax-H3-Max**: The first **2 images** per task are free; additional images are billed per image. Input video is billed by duration at the output resolution. Audio input is free.
https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: * **Payment:** API usage charges are deducted from your account balance.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: * **Rates:** Rates vary by model, API, and configuration. For example, LLM input length and service tier, or video output resolution, can affect pricing.
https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: * **Task types**: For the same model and resolution, all task types share the same unit price. Audio input is free.
https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: * **Video input**: Billed by input duration at the output resolution of the selected model.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: * Input materials from the original task are billed again: the first **5 images** are free and additional images are billed per image; video is billed by the original input duration; audio is free.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: * The regeneration fee is charged separately from the original task fee and includes the regenerated video output fee and input material fees.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: > 1. The billing item is token count; the token-to-character ratio varies slightly depending on the usage scenario, subject to actual consumption
https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: > 2. Token to English word ratio (estimate): approximately 750 English words consume 1000 tokens

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: > For each billing item, multiply actual usage by the applicable unit price. First, convert usage to the unit listed in the pricing table. For example, if a price is listed per million tokens, divide the token count by 1,000,000 before multiplying by the price. If a request includes multiple billing items, add their costs together.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: > H3 video output and input media are billed separately. Images beyond the free allowance incur an additional charge. Input video is billed based on its duration and the output resolution. If you regenerate a video, the input media from the original task is billed again. See the video pricing tables for the applicable rates.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: > Priority gives your requests priority access for faster responses and improved reliability. It costs 1.5 times the Standard rate. To enable it, set `service_tier` to `priority`. See the LLM pricing tables for the rates that apply to each input length.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: > The amounts above are illustrative estimates for generating a single image; even with the same input and output resolutions, actual costs may vary depending on the number of text input tokens in each request. Text input tokens include those generated by prompt enhancement.

View usage and charges on the [API Usage page](https://platform.minimax.io/console/consumption-detail).

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: Find answers to common questions about pay-as-you-go billing and Audio Packages. See the relevant pricing tables for exact prices and included features.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: MiniMax offers pay-as-you-go billing and Audio Packages. Choose a billing option based on the models you use, how much you expect to use them, and for how long.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: See Model Pricing and Tool Pricing for individual rates. Audio Packages are also available for speech models. To compare these options, see [Payment Methods](#guides/compare).

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: Starter, Standard, Pro, Scale, and Business each include a monthly allowance of audio points. The allowance varies by plan. See the [Audio package pricing table](#packages/speech) for included points, voice slots, and rate limits.

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: When API-vlm is called through M Plan, usage deducts from the included M Plan quota according to its pay-as-you-go price. If the included quota is exhausted and purchased Credits are available, additional usage can be automatically covered by purchased Credits.
https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo.md: With pay-as-you-go billing, you use standard Open Platform API keys and pay from your account balance based on usage. All prices are in USD.
